title: Harvesting Expert-Parallel Bubbles for Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2611.24496v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: GPUs are expensive, yet latency-critical large language model (LLM) inference leaves part of them idle. Colocation reclaims this capacity by running best-effort work, such as fine-tuning, alongside serving. Many leading LLMs now use a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, which adds a new source of idle time. Under expert parallelism, MoE experts are spread across GPUs, and because the router sends uneven numbers of tokens to each GPU, lightly loaded GPUs wait for the most loaded one. Even after applying load balancing solutions, such bubbles still take 8--13% of prefill time.   We present BubbleTea, the first colocation system that leverages expert-parallel bubbles for fine-tuning. translated_title: 挖掘专家并行气泡用于微调
translated_abstract: GPU价格昂贵，然而对延迟敏感的大语言模型（LLM）推理服务却使其中一部分GPU处于空闲状态。通过共存方式，即在提供推理服务的同时运行尽力而为的工作负载（如微调），可以回收这部分闲置算力。当前许多领先的LLM采用混合专家（MoE）架构，这带来了新的空闲时间来源。在专家并行机制下，MoE专家被分散部署在多个GPU上，由于路由器向各个GPU发送的token数量不均衡，负载较轻的GPU需要等待负载最重的GPU。即使应用了负载均衡方案，这类气泡（空闲时间）仍占预填充（prefill）时间的8%至13%。我们提出了BubbleTea，这是首个利用专家并行气泡进行微调的共存系统。与现有的每轮前向传播为所有GPU做出统一调度决策的共存系统不同，BubbleTea根据路由器的token分配情况逐层预测每个GPU的气泡时长，并使用可复用……的短微调任务块来填充这些空闲时段（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: BubbleTea是首个利用MoE推理中专家并行因token分配不均产生的空闲气泡时间进行微调的GPU共存系统，它逐层预测每个GPU的气泡并用短微调任务块填充，从而回收这部分被浪费的昂贵算力。
en_tdlr: BubbleTea is the first colocation system that harvests idle expert-parallel bubbles in MoE inference—predicting each GPU's per-layer bubbles from the router's token assignment and filling them with fine-tuning work—to reclaim wasted GPU capacity.
